name: diagrams
description: Manual-layout UML diagrams authored in HTML/CSS, rendered to PNG via headless Chromium.

scripts.test:docker: DG_UID=$(id -u) DG_GID=$(id -g) docker compose run --rm test
scripts.test:docker:update: DG_UID=$(id -u) DG_GID=$(id -g) docker compose run --rm test sh -c "npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error && npm run test:update"
